that step) satisfies the condition.  An obligation becomes pending at any step satisfying the trigger ("START" =
pending from the beginning) and is fulfilled by a later (or the same) step satisfying the discharge; it can be

parsed.text: Carts are prohibited in single-file shelf aisles where the shopper is between shelves on both sides.
A shopper must not enter a single-file shelf aisle while still holding a cart.
Shelf interactions inside a single-file aisle must be performed without a cart.
After arriving with a cart at the wide mouth of a single-file shelf aisle, the shopper is obliged to park the cart before continuing.
After walking out of a single-file shelf aisle without a cart, the shopper is obliged to reclaim the cart.
Movement without a cart is prohibited except in the entrance/cart-bay area, the single-file shelf aisle, or its staging mouth.
Inside a single-file shelf aisle, shoppers must move only along the aisle's length and not laterally.
Once a cart is in use, setting it down is allowed only at the approved wide staging mouth of the single-file shelf aisle.
